name: Capecitabine
histology: invasive breast carcinoma (histology-agnostic; includes invasive ductal carcinoma (IDC) and invasive lobular carcinoma (ILC))

biomarkers.note: Single-agent oral fluoropyrimidine; the cytotoxic backbone is NOT biomarker-restricted. Two grounded uses: (1) adjuvant for residual triple-negative disease after preoperative taxane/alkylator/anthracycline chemotherapy (subtype #3, TNBC; CREATE-X/Masuda), and (2) palliative single-agent therapy for HR-positive/HER2-negative (subtype #5) or HER2-negative recurrent/metastatic disease. Per Standard Guidelines (NCCN), Invasive Breast Cancer, BINV-M 5 of 10 and BINV-Q 9 of 15.

lineOfTherapy: adjuvant (residual TNBC after preoperative chemotherapy) or a single-agent option across lines for HER2-negative recurrent/metastatic disease; not strictly line-scoped

eligibilityCriteria.requirement: residual invasive disease after preoperative taxane-, alkylator-, and anthracycline-based chemotherapy (triple-negative subtype)
eligibilityCriteria.locator: v6.2026, BINV-M 2 of 10 (HR-Negative/HER2-Negative, adjuvant capecitabine for residual disease); dosing BINV-M 5 of 10 reference 6 (Masuda, CREATE-X)

eligibilityCriteria.requirement: HER2-negative recurrent or metastatic breast cancer (HR-positive/HER2-negative or triple-negative), single-agent option across lines
eligibilityCriteria.locator: v6.2026, BINV-Q 9 of 15 (Cytotoxic Regimens for Recurrent or Stage IV Disease: capecitabine single agent)

drugs.name: Capecitabine

provenance.locator: BINV-Q 9 of 15 (Capecitabine 1000 to 1250 mg/m2 PO twice daily on Days 1 to 14; cycled every 21 days); adjuvant BINV-M 5 of 10 (1000 to 1250 mg/m2 PO twice daily Days 1 to 14, every 21 days for 6 to 8 cycles)

drugs.notes: Source: Standard Guidelines (NCCN) v6.2026. The guideline states a dose RANGE of 1000 to 1250 mg/m2 PO twice daily on days 1 to 14 of a 21-day cycle (metastatic monotherapy BINV-Q 9 of 15; adjuvant residual-disease BINV-M 5 of 10). dosePerUnit is set to the lower bound (1000 mg/m2); the full sourced range is 1000 to 1250 mg/m2 twice daily. Adjuvant use is 6 to 8 cycles; metastatic use continues until progression.

supportiveCare: Antiemetics: capecitabine is low-to-moderate emetic risk; prophylaxis per emetogenicity tier.
Counsel on hand-foot syndrome, diarrhea, and stomatitis; hold/reduce per labeling for grade 2 or higher toxicity.
Assess DPYD status per institutional policy before fluoropyrimidine therapy (risk of severe toxicity in DPD deficiency).

monitoring: hepatic and renal function before each cycle
hand-foot syndrome and diarrhea assessment each cycle

doseModificationRules.condition: grade 2 or higher hand-foot syndrome, diarrhea, or stomatitis
doseModificationRules.text: Interrupt capecitabine until resolution to grade 0 to 1, then resume at a reduced dose per labeling; obtain clinical review.
Reduce starting dose or avoid in DPD deficiency due to risk of severe or fatal fluoropyrimidine toxicity; physician decides.

core.source: DeVita, Hellman, and Rosenberg's Cancer: Principles & Practice of Oncology, 12th ed.
core.locator: capecitabine is an established oral fluoropyrimidine in DeVita; the breast-specific per-cycle dose is not tabulated in the breast chapter, so the numeric dose here is taken from the guideline layer

guideline.locator: Dosing: Cytotoxic Regimens for Recurrent/Stage IV Disease, Capecitabine 1000 to 1250 mg/m2 PO twice daily on Days 1 to 14, every 21 days, BINV-Q 9 of 15; adjuvant residual-disease dosing (6 to 8 cycles) BINV-M 5 of 10 reference 6 (Masuda, CREATE-X)

provenanceNote: ONCQIS Standard Protocol draft for single-agent capecitabine. Histology-agnostic (invasive ductal #1 and invasive lobular #2); serves triple-negative subtype #3 in the adjuvant residual-disease setting (CREATE-X/Masuda) and HR-positive/HER2-negative subtype #5 (and HER2-negative disease generally) in the metastatic setting. DeVita establishes capecitabine as an oral fluoropyrimidine but does not tabulate the breast per-cycle dose; the dose is therefore sourced to Standard Guidelines (NCCN) v6.2026: 1000 to 1250 mg/m2 PO twice daily on days 1 to 14 of a 21-day cycle (metastatic BINV-Q 9 of 15; adjuvant residual-disease 6 to 8 cycles BINV-M 5 of 10). dosePerUnit is set to the lower bound of the sourced range (1000 mg/m2), with the full 1000 to 1250 mg/m2 twice-daily range recorded in the drug notes. No field is set to VERIFY. This remains a StewardMD Standard Protocol; no endorsement implied.
